subject: Rebooting MAP: new champion & roles for Procurely evaluation
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Janelle Morris <janelle.morris@procurely.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Rebooting MAP: new champion & roles for Procurely evaluation

Hi Janelle — good to reconnect.

Thanks again for the note about the org changes last month. I understand Priya moved to a different program, and you now have a new internal sponsor for the proof-of-concept. To avoid losing the momentum we had, I put together a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that focuses the next 6 weeks on evaluation milestones, tech validation, and procurement gates.

Attached: MAP_draft_v3.pdf and Procurely_eval_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet with proposed test cases and timeline). Also confirming receipt of the signed NDA on our side (NDA_signed_Procurely.pdf).

Key asks from our side:
- Please confirm the new champion and their role for approvals (who signs procurement, who owns security questions).
- Identify the primary technical contact for an initial environment walkthrough and data mapping.
- Confirm budget approval path and target close date (we've penciled in Aug 1 for contract execution to align with Q3 rollout plans).

Suggested 30/60/90 MAP milestones (high level):
- Week 1: kickoff call, access provisioning, success criteria signoff
- Weeks 2–3: integration test plan + demo with sample dataset
- Weeks 4–5: performance and cost review; quantization/latency checks
- Week 6: executive review & procurement signoff

Would you be able to introduce the new champion and the technical lead on this thread? If it helps, I can send a short intake form to collect environment details ahead of the kickoff.

Thanks — look forward to re-engaging.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_draft_v3.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: Procurely_eval_plan.xlsx (XLSX)]
[Attachment: NDA_signed_Procurely.pdf (PDF)]

From: Janelle Morris <janelle.morris@procurely.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@procurely.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rebooting MAP: new champion & roles for Procurely evaluation

Thanks Camila — and thanks for pulling this together so quickly. We did lose a bit of momentum while we reorganized. Introducing Tom Becker (cc'ed) — he is our new AI Platform Lead and will be the technical champion for the POC.

Tom will drive environment access and the integration tests; I will remain the exec sponsor for budget and procurement gating. Tom, quick context: Redwood helped us run a small pilot earlier this year and the team liked the latency/cost profile. We want to validate performance on our procurement datasets and confirm the security posture before vendor approval.

Tom — could you confirm who on your team needs to be looped in (infra, data engineering, security), and whether the proposed Aug 1 target is realistic from a procurement calendar perspective?

Janelle Morris
Head of Product Operations
Procurely

From: Tom Becker <tom.becker@procurely.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Janelle Morris <janelle.morris@procurely.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rebooting MAP: new champion & roles for Procurely evaluation

Hi all — thanks Janelle and Camila. Quick answers from my side:
- I'll be the technical champion and will own the POC sign-off for infra and performance.
- Infra contacts: Lila Chen (data infra), Matt Ruiz (platform ops). Security reviewer: Anika Patel (security/compliance). I can loop them after this thread if you want.
- Aug 1 feels tight for procurement signature but feasible if we keep to the 6-week MAP and get timely answers on the security questionnaire.

Can we schedule the kickoff for Wed 9th at 11:00am PT for a 45-minute session? I propose the agenda: introductions, objectives & success criteria, access & data needs, timeline checklist, next steps.

Two quick clarifications on the MAP doc:
1) Under "performance tests" can you add a 95th percentile latency target for our 8k token batch? We need to ensure tail latency meets user-experience SLAs.
2) For the procurement path, we use a two-stage PO flow; it would be helpful to call out the legal review window (2 weeks) in the timeline.

I'll also attach a short internal checklist (not attached here) and will follow up with the names for Lila/Matt/Anika.

Best,
Tom Becker
AI Platform Lead
Procurely

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Tom Becker <tom.becker@procurely.com>, Janelle Morris <janelle.morris@procurely.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rebooting MAP: new champion & roles for Procurely evaluation

Tom — perfect, thanks. Wed 9th 11:00am PT works for us. I'll send a calendar invite and a short intake form for Lila/Matt/Anika to fill (data sample format, expected QPS, and access method).

I've updated the MAP_draft_v3.pdf to include the 95th pct latency row (8k token batch) and called out the 2-week legal review as a procurement gate. New version is attached as MAP_draft_v3_annotated.pdf and I also added a short "who owns what" table to make approvals explicit.

Proposed kickoff agenda (45 min):
- 5m intros + roles
- 10m success criteria & scope (data sets, scale)
- 15m access plan & integration tests
- 10m procurement/legal checklist and timeline
- 5m immediate next steps & owners

Next steps:
1) I'll send calendar invite and intake form today.
2) Tom/Janelle to confirm Lila/Matt/Anika for access and security questionnaire.
3) Rafael and I will prepare an environment access playbook and a short demo focused on the 8k token performance case.

Thanks — attaching the annotated MAP for your review.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_draft_v3_annotated.pdf (PDF)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Rebooting MAP: new champion & roles for Procurely evaluation

Looping in the internal ops crew — I reviewed the annotated MAP and the 8k token latency target looks achievable on our Dedicated profile with the suggested batching and KV cache settings. Camila — please add the playbook section for access steps (SSH keys, SSO grants, sample dataset upload) and I will prep a brief runbook for the kickoff.

We'll aim to have the demo environment ready by Tue 8th EOD so the Wed 9th call can be focused on validation, not setup.

-Rafael
Head of Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
snippet: Rebooting the MAP after org change — new technical champion introduced (Tom Becker). Camila attached updated MAP with latency/ procurement callouts and scheduled a kickoff for Wed 9th. Rafael to prep demo env.
